title: Runtime Topology Maintenance
goal: Keep Hussh's metadata-only route, agent, database-family, compatibility, and documentation indexes current without creating a second runtime router or autonomous mutation path.
required_commands: cd hushh-webapp && npm run verify:surface-map && npm run verify:route-orchestration-index && npm run audit:cache-coherence

commands: cd hushh-webapp && npm run verify:surface-map && npm run verify:route-orchestration-index && npm run audit:cache-coherence

deliverables: explicit route alias and semantic-route metadata
revision-bound drift report with verified, failed, and unverified evidence
impact_fields: Route, semantic tab, cache, native, and voice/action coverage
Database family ownership and retirement posture
common_failures: creating a runtime maintenance agent or second action router
treating generated index metadata as executable authority
deleting compatibility routes or tables without usage, retention, and recovery evidence
hiding an expired compatibility deadline instead of recording an explicit decision
letting a generated registry or topology projection go stale
